text: Done, fresh-context reviewed, fixes applied; merged. Policy: write-earliest with an explicit SchemaLadder (a version cannot exist without its upcast), lift validates before upcasting, registry derived from ladders. Identity: SHA-256 CanonicalDigest (typed by what it identifies) for anything persisted or cited across files/runs; FNV ContentHash stays in-memory only. Canonical wire forms enforced (NonCanonical). 4,445 tests; API audit zero uncovered. Contract for UI-D: RunStamp compares CanonicalDigests.
